# Workflow Skills

This folder stores the repo-hosted skill content for the Sopra workflow pipeline.

## What this is

- A shared skill pack that documents the workflow stages
- A restartable artifact model for analysis, planning, implementation, and testing
- Companion content for the `workflow-skills` extension in `.github/extensions/`

## How to use

Copy or reference this folder in projects that need the same workflow pattern.

## Stages

- Analyze project
- Present analysis
- Grill me
- Create plan
- Review plan
- Implement plan
- Test solution

## Notes

The extension provides the executable tools; this folder stores the reusable skill guidance in the repo.

## Example sources

Use the Microsoft CAT agent skills gallery when refining these stages:

- https://microsoft.github.io/cat-agent-skills/?tag=productivity
